summary: Segnalazioni / Feedback feature validated end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 tests pass covering create (guest + authenticated), validation (empty title/description, invalid category, 413 oversized attachment), admin list with status/category/search filters + sort asc/desc, unread-count, single GET (with attachments + auto mark-read + 404), PATCH status transitions + invalid + 404, DELETE, and /admin/stats reports/reports_new counts. Frontend: Public Ospite → Profilo → 'Segnala un problema' → fill category+title+description → submit flow works, success screen 'Segnalazione ricevuta!' renders. Verified the guest submission from UI persisted with user_id=null and correct category. Admin UI not tested via browser per request (Google gate + ADMINTESTTOKEN123 cannot pass welcome gate).
action_items: None blocking. Feature is production-ready from backend + public frontend perspective.
Optional: consider adding /api/admin/reports pagination + total count for large volumes (currently .to_list(500) hard cap).
Optional: PATCH status endpoint always sets read=True on update; if a workflow requires marking unread while updating status, this side-effect might be undesirable — currently acceptable.
Optional (perf): search regex on user_email/user_name/title/description is unindexed; if reports grow large, consider a text index.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/reports POST correctly validates category, trims title/description, rejects >12MB base64 attachments (screenshot AND video), and captures optional auth user via get_optional_user — clean.
server.py: /api/admin/reports list correctly excludes screenshot/video from projection to keep list payload light; single GET returns full doc — good separation.
server.py: opening a report (GET single) auto-marks read=True — matches unread badge UX; PATCH also sets read=True.
server.py: _id excluded from all responses (find(..., {'_id':0}) / find_one(..., {'_id':0})) — no ObjectId serialization issue.
server.py: all response payloads pass through FastAPI's default jsonable encoder — datetime objects (created_at/updated_at) are serialized to ISO strings, so the sort comparison in tests works.
frontend/app/report.tsx: KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' is correct; touch targets on chips + attach buttons are ≥44pt.
frontend/app/report.tsx: Videos are read as base64 blob via FileReader and guarded to 8MB before upload — matches backend's 12MB base64 limit.
frontend/app/(tabs)/profilo.tsx: 'Segnala un problema' menu entry is present and always visible (guest + authenticated) — good UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (public flow: Welcome → Ospite → Profilo → Report → Success verified)

seed_data_creation: Test file creates TEST_-prefixed reports and a TEST_reports_<uuid>@pescatoridiuomini.it user via /api/auth/register during the run. A session-scoped autouse cleanup fixture purges all TEST_-prefixed reports after the test session. UI-created report (rep_13c9b1a2a513) also manually deleted post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_reports.py — reusable regression suite for the Segnalazioni feature. Uses ADMINTESTTOKEN123 (seeded by conftest.py). Frontend admin UI is behind Google welcome gate + admin allowlist, so admin browser automation is intentionally skipped; validate admin UI manually or via a real Google login. The parallel xdist workers can race on shared counters (unread-count), so avoid ==count-1 assertions across workers.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. During test authoring, two flakes were caught & fixed in the test itself (not product code): (1) a module-level teardown that wiped TEST_ reports mid-run on the first-finishing xdist worker → moved cleanup to a session-scope autouse fixture; (2) unread-count race between parallel workers → replaced count-arithmetic assertion with a per-report list lookup checking read flag transition.
